You must answer on the enclosed answer booklet.
You will need: Answer booklet (enclosed)
Answer one question from your chosen Depth Study.
Follow the instructions on the front cover of the answer booklet. If you need additional answer paper,
ask the invigilator for a continuation booklet.
Answer one question from your chosen Depth Study.
DEPTH STUDY A: THE FIRST WORLD WAR, 1914–18
1 How important was the Battle of Mons to the course of the war by the end of 1914? Explain your
answer. [40]
How significant were the Turkish defences as a cause of Allied failure in the Gallipoli Campaign of
1915? Explain your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY B: GERMANY, 1918–45
How important was hyperinflation as a cause of unrest in Weimar Germany by 1923? Explain your
answer. [40]
How significant were Nazi actions against the communists in allowing Hitler to strengthen his position
between 1933 and 1934? Explain your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY C: RUSSIA, 1905–41
How important was the 1905 Revolution in weakening Tsarist rule in Russia by 1914? Explain your
answer. [40]
How significant was propaganda in shaping the lives of Soviet citizens in the 1930s? Explain your
answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY D: THE UNITED STATES, 1919–41
How important was Henry Ford to the economic prosperity of the USA in the 1920s? Explain your
answer. [40]
How significant was the Works Progress Administration in dealing with the problem of unemployment
in the 1930s? Explain your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY E: CHINA, c.1930–c.1990
How important were the actions of the Nationalist government during the Second World War in
bringing about Communist victory in 1949? Explain your answer. [40]
How significant was the Great Leap Forward to the development of Communist China by 1960?
Explain your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY F: SOUTH AFRICA, c.1940–c.1994
How important was government legislation on land ownership to the maintenance of segregation
in South Africa before 1948? Explain your answer. [40]
How significant was Steve Biko in challenging white minority rule in South Africa? Explain your
answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY G: ISRAELIS AND PALESTINIANS SINCE 1945
How important was Zionism as a cause of conflict in Palestine by 1948? Explain your answer.[40]
How significant was the First Intifada in the development of Arab-Israeli relations? Explain your
answer. [40]
